sufficiencyReasons: Core additive/subtractive structure (Consolidated Net Income plus clause (1) addbacks minus clause (2) deductions) is fully represented with citations to each lettered clause and consumes all 53 frozen-inventory items either via node attachment or explicit disposition.

Clause (d)'s election-to-defer/future-period-clawback mechanic and clause (h)'s dependency on a prior period's clause (2) deduction are cross-period procedural mechanics that cannot be expressed as a single-period static value; represented via a nested UNSUPPORTED node (clause (d)) or descriptive attachment (clause (h)) rather than a computed amount.

The clause (l) cap (15% of Acquired EBITDA) is, by its own terms, a joint ceiling shared with amounts separately included pursuant to Section 1.07(3) (a different Section, not itself a modeled rule in this submission); the MIN node modeling this cap is a simplification that does not net out the Section 1.07(3) portion of usage, since that usage is not quantified anywhere in the evidence provided.

The clause (f)/(m)/(n) 10% cap references 'Consolidated EBITDA (calculated without giving effect to such addbacks)', a self-referential base amount represented as a distinct METRIC_REFERENCE rather than recursively expanded, to avoid an unbounded self-referential tree.

The instruction that Consolidated EBITDA (including pro forma adjustments) be calculated in accordance with Section 1.07 is a calculation-methodology cross-reference, not a discrete formula component, and is dispositioned as non-computational.

irExtensionCandidates.sourceEvidence: §1.01 cl.(l): '...taken together with the aggregate amount included pursuant to Section 1.07(3), shall not exceed 15% of Acquired EBITDA...'
irExtensionCandidates.semanticRequirement: A WireDefinition's own internal formula component sometimes shares a single aggregate ceiling with an amount computed under an entirely different, non-defined-term section (here, Section 1.07(3)'s pro forma run-rate synergy adjustments) that is not itself represented as a WireRule or WireDefinition in the submission.
irExtensionCandidates.whyExistingPrimitivesFail: WireSharedCapacity/memberRefs and WireRule.dependsOn exist for exactly this cross-unit sharing pattern between RULES, but WireDefinition has no analogous dependsOn/cross-reference field, so the cross-section joint ceiling can only be approximated inside the calculationExpression as a one-sided MIN (ignoring the other provision's usage) or described in free-text notes, rather than preserved as an explicit, structured unresolved cross-unit dependency.
irExtensionCandidates.candidateGeneralizedPrimitive: Add an optional dependsOn array (same shape as WireRule.dependsOn, e.g. relationshipType SHARES_CAPACITY_WITH with a targetRef section reference) to WireDefinition so a defined term's own formula can flag a joint ceiling shared with a provision outside the definition itself.

irExtensionCandidates.sourceEvidence: §1.01 cl.(f): '...in each case to the extent permitted hereunder'; cl.(i): 'to the extent that such costs or expenses are funded with cash proceeds contributed to the capital...'
irExtensionCandidates.semanticRequirement: Individual addback/deduction components of a defined-term formula are frequently gated by their own scope-limiting conditions (e.g., 'to the extent permitted hereunder', 'to the extent funded with cash proceeds...') that are logically conditions on that specific formula component, not on the definition as a whole.
irExtensionCandidates.whyExistingPrimitivesFail: WireRule has a first-class `conditions` array for exactly this purpose, but WireDefinition only exposes a single calculationExpression tree with no parallel conditions array, forcing such conditions to be folded into a node's citation/excerpt/inventoryItemIds rather than represented as a structured, independently-typed condition expression.
irExtensionCandidates.candidateGeneralizedPrimitive: Add an optional `conditions` array (same WireCondition shape used by WireRule) to WireDefinition, attachable at the definition level or (ideally) to any individual expression node, to preserve per-component gating conditions as structured logic rather than descriptive text.

This submission compiles only the 'Consolidated EBITDA' definition in §1.01, as instructed; other definitions appearing in Phase 2's context bundle (e.g. Consolidated Depreciation and Amortization Expense, Indebtedness, Total Net Leverage Ratio, etc.) are pre-existing sibling/dependency terms supplied for context and are referenced via DEFINED_TERM_REFERENCE/dependsOnTerms rather than re-emitted as separate WireDefinitions, since they were not the operative source text tasked for compilation here.

All 53 frozen semantic inventory items are accounted for: 51 are consumed on the specific expression node that carries their value/condition/exception/dependency meaning, and 2 (clause (g) 'reserved', and the Section 1.07 pro forma cross-reference) are dispositioned INTENTIONALLY_NON_COMPUTATIONAL because they are real but non-additive/non-subtractive drafting features.

The deterministically-flagged unlisted PERCENT 15% value from region xref-2 (Section 1.07(3)) is the same substantive 15% of Acquired EBITDA ceiling stated in clause (l) of this definition (the two provisions expressly cross-reference and share one aggregate ceiling); it is folded into the clause (l) MIN node's citation/excerpt rather than treated as a second, additive 15% threshold.

Two self-referential/ joint-ceiling simplifications are flagged in sufficiencyReasons and as irExtensionCandidates: (1) the clause (f)/(m)/(n) 10% cap's base ('Consolidated EBITDA calculated without giving effect to such addbacks') is modeled as a distinct METRIC_REFERENCE rather than recursively expanded; (2) the clause (l)/Section 1.07(3) shared 15% ceiling is modeled as a one-sided MIN because Section 1.07(3)'s own usage amount is not quantified in the evidence provided and WireDefinition has no cross-unit dependsOn field.

Codification Topic No. 810, Consolidation; plus

were equityholders at the time of, and entitled to share in, such distribution, in each case to the extent permitted hereunder; plus

(g) [reserved]; plus

(h) cash receipts (or any netting arrangements resulting in reduced cash expenditures) not representing Consolidated EBITDA or
Consolidated Net Income in any prior period to the extent non-cash gains relating to such income were deducted in the calculation of Consolidated EBITDA pursuant to clause (2) below for any previous
period and not added back; plus
(i) any costs or expenses incurred pursuant to any management equity plan, stock
option plan or any other management or employee benefit plan, agreement or any stock subscription or shareholder agreement, to the extent that such costs or expenses are funded with cash proceeds contributed to the capital of such Person or net cash
proceeds of an issuance of Equity Interests of such Person (other than Disqualified Stock); plus
(j) any net
pension or other post-employment benefit costs representing amortization of unrecognized prior service costs, actuarial losses, including amortization of such amounts arising in prior periods, amortization of the unrecognized net obligation (and
loss or cost) existing at the date of initial application of FASB Accounting Standards Codification Topic 715—Compensation—Retirement Benefits, and any other items of a similar nature, plus

18

(k) Transaction Expenses; plus

(l) the amount of “run-rate” cost savings, synergies and operating expense
reductions related to any Permitted Acquisition that are projected by the Borrower in good faith to result from actions either taken or with respect to which substantial steps have been taken or are expected to be taken (in the good faith
determination of the Borrower) within 12 months after the end of such period (which cost savings, synergies or operating expense reductions shall be calculated on a pro forma basis as though such cost savings, synergies or operating expense
reductions had been realized on the first day of such period), net of the amount of actual benefits realized from such actions during such period (it is understood and agreed that “run-rate” means
the full recurring benefit that is associated with any action taken or with respect to which substantial steps have been taken or are expected to be taken, whether prior to or following the Closing Date) (which adjustments may be incremental to (but
not duplicative of) pro forma cost savings, synergies or operating expense reduction adjustments made pursuant to Section 1.07); provided that (i) such cost savings, synergies and operating expense reductions are reasonably
identifiable and factually supportable and (ii) the aggregate amount of cost savings, synergies and operating expense reductions included pursuant to this clause (l), with respect to Permitted Acquisitions taken together with the aggregate
amount included pursuant to Section 1.07(3), shall not exceed 15% of Acquired EBITDA in any Test Period (prior to giving effect to Section 1.07(3) or this clause (l)); plus

(m) extraordinary, non-recurring or unusual losses, fees, costs, charges or expenses
(including relating to any strategic initiatives and accruals and reserves in connection with such gains, losses, charges or expenses), restructuring costs, charges, accruals or reserves (including, without limitation, restructuring and integration
costs related to acquisitions, facility closures, workforce reductions and adjustments to existing reserves, and in each case, whether or not classified as such under GAAP); plus

(n) any payments in the nature of compensation or expense reimbursement made to independent board members; plus

(o) internal software development costs that are expensed during the period but could have been capitalized in accordance with
GAAP; plus
(p) any loss from discontinued operations (but if such operations are classified as discontinued due to
the fact that they are subject to an agreement to dispose of such operations, only when and to the extent such operations are actually disposed of);

provided, that the aggregate amount of any amounts added back to Consolidated EBITDA pursuant to clauses (f), (m) and
(n) above shall not exceed 10% of Consolidated EBITDA (calculated without giving effect to any such addbacks) in any Test Period; and

(2) decreased (without duplication) by the following, in each case to the extent included in determining Consolidated Net
Income for such period:
(a) non-cash gains for such period (excluding any non-cash gain to the extent it represents the reversal of an accrual or reserve for a potential cash item that reduced Consolidated Net Income or Consolidated EBITDA in any prior period other than any such accrual
or reserve that has been added back to Consolidated Net Income in calculating Consolidated EBITDA in accordance with this definition),

(b) the amount of any non-controlling interest consisting of loss attributable to non-controlling interests of third parties in any non-wholly owned Subsidiary added to (and not deducted from) Consolidated Net Income in such period,

19

(c) any net income from discontinued operations (but if such operations are
classified as discontinued due to the fact that they are subject to an agreement to dispose of such operations, only when and to the extent such operations are actually disposed of); and

(d) any extraordinary, non-recurring or unusual gains.

For the avoidance of doubt, Consolidated EBITDA shall be calculated, including pro forma adjustments, in accordance with
Section 1.07.

SECTION 1.07 Pro Forma and Other Calculations.

(1) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, financial ratios and tests, including the First Lien Net Leverage Ratio, the Secured Net
Leverage Ratio, the Total Net Leverage Ratio and the Interest Coverage Ratio shall be calculated in the manner prescribed by this Section 1.07; provided that notwithstanding anything to the contrary in clauses (2), (3), (4) or
(5) of this Section 1.07 when calculating the First Lien Net Leverage Ratio, the Secured Net Leverage Ratio or Total Net Leverage Ratio, as applicable, for purposes of (a) the definition of “Applicable Rate,” (b)
Section 2.05(2)(a) and (c) the Financial Covenant (other than for the purpose of determining pro forma compliance with the Financial Covenant), the events described in this Section 1.07 that occurred subsequent to the end of
the applicable Test Period shall not be given pro forma effect; provided however that voluntary prepayments made pursuant to Section 2.05(1) during any fiscal year (without duplication of any prepayments in such fiscal year
that reduced the amount of Excess Cash Flow required to be repaid pursuant to Section 2.05(2)(a) for any prior fiscal year) shall be given pro forma effect after such fiscal year-end and prior to
the time any mandatory prepayment pursuant to Section 2.05(2)(a) is due for purposes of calculating the First Lien Net Leverage Ratio for purposes of determining the ECF Percentage for such mandatory prepayment, if any. In addition, whenever a
financial ratio or test is to be calculated on a pro forma basis, the reference to “Test Period” for purposes of calculating such financial ratio or test shall be deemed to be a reference to, and shall be based on, the most recently
ended Test Period for which financial statements of the Borrower have been delivered to the Administrative Agent pursuant to Section 6.01(1) or Section 6.01(2), as applicable (it being understood that for purposes of (x) determining
pro forma compliance with the Financial Covenant, if no Test Period with an applicable level cited in the Financial Covenant has passed, the applicable level shall be the level for the first Test Period cited in the Financial Covenant with an
indicated level and (y) determining actual compliance (and not pro forma compliance) with the Financial Covenant, the reference to “Test Period” shall be deemed to be a reference to, and shall be based on, the most recently
ended Test Period for which financial statements have been or are required to be delivered pursuant to Section 6.01(1) or (2)).
(2)
For purposes of calculating any financial ratio or test (or Consolidated EBITDA or Total Assets), Specified Transactions (and, subject to clause (4) below, the incurrence or repayment of any Indebtedness in connection therewith) that have been

that all such Specified Transactions (and any increase or decrease in Consolidated EBITDA and the component financial definitions used therein attributable to any Specified Transaction) had occurred

on the first day of the applicable Test Period (or, in the case of Total Assets, on the last day of the applicable Test Period). If since the beginning of any applicable Test Period any Person
that subsequently became a Subsidiary or was merged, amalgamated or consolidated with or into the Borrower or any Subsidiary since the beginning of such Test Period shall have made any Specified Transaction that would have required adjustment
pursuant to this Section 1.07, then such financial ratio or test (or Consolidated EBITDA or Total Assets) shall be calculated to give pro forma effect thereto in accordance with this Section 1.07.

findings.sourceEvidence: the aggregate amount of cost savings, synergies and operating expense reductions included pursuant to this clause (l), with respect to Permitted Acquisitions taken together with the aggregate amount included pursuant to Section 1.07(3), shall not exceed 15% of Acquired EBITDA in any Test Period (prior to giving effect to Section 1.07(3) or this clause (l)); provided that (i) such cost savings, synergies and operating expense reductions are reasonably identifiable and factually supportable
findings.proposedIrEvidence: MIN(SUBTRACT(GrossRunRateSavings, ActualBenefitsRealized), MULTIPLY(0.15, AcquiredEBITDA)) — cited as '§1.01 cl.(l); Section 1.07(3)' with excerpt 'cf. Section 1.07(3) mirrors the same 15% of Acquired EBITDA ceiling'
findings.verifierReasoning: The source requires the clause (l) run-rate add-back amount to be aggregated together with the amount already included pursuant to Section 1.07(3) before being tested against the single 15% of Acquired EBITDA ceiling ("taken together with the aggregate amount included pursuant to Section 1.07(3)"). The proposed IR instead tests the clause (l) amount alone against the 15% ceiling, treating Section 1.07(3) as merely a parallel/mirrored cap rather than a shared, combined cap. This is a wrong formula shape: it could allow a company to add back up to 15% of Acquired EBITDA under clause (l) AND separately up to 15% under Section 1.07(3), when the source intends a single combined 15% ceiling across both. The IR also silently drops the qualitative precondition that such savings be 'reasonably identifiable and factually supportable,' which is an independently stated proviso in the source. A reviewer computing available EBITDA add-back capacity under a hypothetical acquisition with both clause (l) and Section 1.07(3) run-rate synergies could reach a materially different (larger) permitted add-back under the proposed IR than the source actually allows.

findings.verifierReasoning: The definition's final sentence is an independently operative directive stating that the entire Consolidated EBITDA calculation, including pro forma adjustments, must be performed 'in accordance with Section 1.07.' This governs how the whole metric (not just the clause (l) run-rate synergy carve-out, which is the only place Section 1.07 appears in the proposed IR's provenance) is computed for any Test Period involving acquisitions, dispositions, or other pro forma events. The proposed IR's dependsOnTerms list omits Section 1.07 entirely, and no expression node in the calculationExpression represents this governing cross-reference outside the narrow clause (l) context. A future consumer of this IR who relies on dependsOnTerms to identify all governing provisions would not know that pro forma adjustment methodology under Section 1.07 applies to the metric as a whole, which could produce an incomplete or incorrect EBITDA calculation in any period involving acquisitions or dispositions.
